messages:
rachel: Heads-up: onboarding smoke tests for the new sample-workspace failed during publish. This time the regendiff changed a generated helper signature order which broke sample-app tests AND bumped the release stamp.

devops-bot: CI: release/sample-workspace #722 failed  regendiff + test failures detected (see logs).

rachel: regendiff excerpt:
```
- export function createUser(id: string, opts?: { name?: string; email?: string })
+ export function createUser(opts?: { name?: string; email?: string }, id: string)
```

tom: whoa, changing param order in generated helpers is a breaking change. How did that get through? That should have been caught by our semver/regen checks.

nate: sounds like the codegen emission order changed in 3.5.0 -> 3.5.1; typegen then emitted the overload with swapped params. Our regendiff flagged it, and release-stamp picked it up and bumped minor. But the sample-app test expects positional args and now fails.

maria: immediate unblock options: (1) revert the generated commit and pin the release to previous published package, (2) add a compatibility shim in the sample-app generated surface (thin wrapper restoring old signature), (3) roll back codegen patch.

rachel: for the release we need fastest safe option. I can open a PR that adds a small wrapper in packages/sample-app/src/api/compat.ts that re-exposes the old signature and delegates to the new generated function.

tom: do that but also file a blocker ticket for eng-ml to freeze codegen for patch releases until we adjust typegen to preserve stable param ordering. We need a long-term fix.

nate: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sample-workspace/pull/722  adds compat wrapper + unit test, pins @redwood/codegen to 3.5.0 in workspace. Added CI smoke job that runs sample tests post-publish in a sandbox.

devops-bot: CI started for PR #722.

maria: tiny nit: document the compat wrapper with a TODO linking the codegen issue and add a changelog note about the temporary shim. Product will want to know we intentionally avoided a breaking minor bump for the sample-app.

rachel: added changelog entry and a note in PR description. Also added INF-1701 referencing codegen param-order regression.

devops-bot: CI finished: tests + regen-idempotency passed for PR #722.

tom: merging now. Once merged, retrigger the release pipeline.

devops-bot: Release pipeline retried  publish step reached. No regendiff blocking. Publish succeeded: sample-sdk v0.9.0 published.

nate: follow-ups: 1) eng-ml to add a deterministic parameter emission pass in codegen (RFC), 2) typegen to detect signature-only shuffles and treat them as semver-breaking by default (so release-stamp won't silently auto-bump minor without dev approval), 3) add a sample-app integration that runs the freshly published package against the local sample test suite before final stamp.

maria: I will bring the product sign-off for changing release-stamp semantics. We can't silently accept signature shuffles.

rachel: thanks team. Closing loop: release unblocked, shim in place, RFC requests filed. Leaving thread open while RFC lands. :white_check_mark:
